messages:
alex: quick micro-standup — onboarding + evals check.
What I did: pushed tiny promptset change for es-spanish onboarding (removed a noisy system prompt), ran a quick eval sweep on 3k examples. KV-cache looks warm.
Blockers: seeing ~3% BLEU drop on short instructions for the smallq variant; suspect tokenization mismatch on a few examples. Also one failing CI job on model-conversion (see link).
Today: triage the BLEU drop, add a focused prompt probe, and land the conversion fix if tests pass. If I hit a blocker I'll ping infra.

maria: noted. can you paste the failing example IDs? I can try repro locally with the fast tokenizer.

alex: sure — failing IDs: 2345, 6789, 9012. repro flow I ran: `python eval/run_eval.py --model llama3-smallq --promptset es-onboard --split smoke`.

sam: tagging for awareness — I rolled a tiny patch to kv-warmup that might affect ordering. not sure it's related but worth checking. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/412 (small change to async warmup ordering).

taylor: i'll take the tokenization angle. quick check: did you use the byte-level tokenizer vs wordpiece? sometimes the spanish test cases hit edge whitespace.

alex: used byte-bpe. will try wordpiece and post diffs.

ronit: CI bot shows ```ERROR: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while quantizing layer 12``` I queued a retry.

ci-bot: build #7412 retried by ronit — queued. (reaction :thumbsup:)

maria: if alex's repro shows it's tokenizer-induced, we can add a small input-normalization step in the promptset generator (strip zero-width, normalize punctuation) — low-risk.

alex: good plan. I'll try normalization + alternate tokenizer. If results improve, i'll prepare a tiny patch and request review from taylor + sam.

sam: quick heads-up — if we patch prompt generator, we should also add a unit test with those failing IDs so it doesn't regress.

alex: agreed. adding test to `tests/evals/test_promptsets.py` with the three examples.

taylor: lgtm. ping me when PR's up and i'll do a quick code + perf glance.

ronit: keeping an eye on CI. if OOM persists, i'll spin a larger runner for the conversion step for the retry.

alex: thanks all — i'll update thread after repro. short and focused today. :sparkles:

maria: thanks, team.

(End of thread)
